table_row: The selected record scope is incomplete | Absence of an intermediate record alone cannot establish adjacency certainty
narrative: A query such as FILTER NOT EXISTS establishes absence within its evaluated view, not absence in every model. If the declared scope is known or suspected to be incomplete, the same A/B pair that looked directly-succeeding under a complete-scope assumption (TP-S2) must not be reported as certain direct succession; it is at best a possible one, contingent on an explicit completeness policy the decision document has not yet defined.

precedes.basis: strict interval inequality is unaffected by scope completeness

direct_succession_within_declared_scope.basis: scope is declared incomplete; an unrecorded intervening process cannot be ruled out
